items.question: By what mode of perfect fusion and turning back does this power operate on all sides?
premises: The power acts by the nature of perfect fusion.
The same power operates through turning back.
This operation extends on all sides.
items.inference: This power functions universally through inward reversal grounded in perfect fusion.
uncertainties: The exact referent of sā+eṣā depends on the immediately preceding verses.
items.plain_english: By the nature of perfect fusion, this same power, through turning back, operates on all sides.

items.question: What quality intensifies the union through wonder arising from the enjoyment of sense objects?
premises: Sense-object enjoyment gives rise to wonder.
That wonder serves as an augmenting force.
The described state is intensified by this wonder.
items.inference: The union is strengthened by the camatkāra born from the enjoyment of sense objects.
uncertainties: The substantive qualified by this adjective is supplied by the following verse.
items.plain_english: It is augmented by the wonder that arises from the enjoyment of sense objects.

items.question: What characterizes the intimate union that abides in seed form as the inward self?
